// Package more covers the rest of the translated forms, across two files that
// declare some C names twice, identically.
package more

/*
#cgo noescape fill
#cgo nocallback fill
#cgo LDFLAGS: -lfake
typedef struct { int a; } anon_t;
typedef enum { ANON_A, ANON_B = -1 } anon_e;
union one { int only; };
static int twice(int v) { return v * 2; }
int sum(int n, ...);
typedef void (*callback_t)(int);
typedef void handler_t(int);
void fill(char buf[8]);
typedef char name_t[4];
void name(name_t n);
int errno_call(void);
_Bool flag(void);
double ratio(float f);
struct never_defined;
void *opaque(struct never_defined *p);
#define CHAR_C 'x'
#define FLOAT_C 1.5f
#define NEG_C (-3)
#define ALIAS_C NEG_C
*/
import "C"

import _ "syscall" // the generated cgo file imports it

func A() C.anon_t    { return C.anon_t{a: 1} }
func E() C.anon_e    { return C.ANON_B }
func U() C.union_one { return C.union_one{only: 1} }
func Twice() C.int   { return C.twice(2) }
func Sum() C.int     { return C.sum(1) }
func Fill(b *C.char) { C.fill(b) }
func Name(n *C.char) { C.name(n) }
func Str() *C.char   { return C.CString("x") }
func Flag() bool     { return bool(C.flag()) }
func Ratio() float64 { return float64(C.ratio(1)) }
func Opaque() any    { return C.opaque(nil) }
func Addr() any      { return C.twice }
func Handler() any   { var h *C.handler_t; return h }

var CB C.callback_t

func Errno() (C.int, error) {
	v, err := C.errno_call()
	return v, err
}

const (
	Char  = C.CHAR_C
	Float = C.FLOAT_C
	Neg   = C.NEG_C
	Alias = C.ALIAS_C
)
